sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 25 (check 24), Internal Quality Checks row 25, Deterministic Checks rows for check-rubric-schema.py, check-scoring-policy.py, check-verifier-contract.py, check-canonical-shared-files.py, check-required-files.py
evidence: Static review of the frozen bytes; all five judge.toml files were parsed with tomllib. (1) tests/scoring.toml is byte-identical to the frozen template: '[gates] render = 0.0 / constraints = 0.0', '[weights] functional = 0.6 / polish = 0.2 / visual = 0.2' (positive, sum 1.0), '[floors] functional = 0.05'; every listed name has its directory in the right suite (tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/functional, tests/scored/polish, tests/scored/visual) and no other dimension directory exists. (2) In all five judge.toml files everything above the first [[criterion]] is byte-identical to the template: 'judge = "claude-code"' (matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE in task.toml), 'mode = "batched"', 'isolated = false', 'prompt_template = "prompt.md"', no model / reasoning_effort / temperature / weight key in [judge]; each declares the playwright stdio server 'command = "playwright-mcp"', 'args = ["--headless", "--isolated", "--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium", "--no-sandbox"]', and tests/Dockerfile (identical to template) installs @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and links /usr/local/bin/chromium. Gates use 'aggregation = "all_pass"', scored dimensions 'weighted_mean'. (3) Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares the second server 'name = "verifier"', 'command = "/usr/local/bin/python3"', 'args = ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]'; tests/test.sh (identical to template) writes the helper, chmods it 755 and runs 'export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"' before either suite; tests/tools/restart_mcp.py (identical to template) exposes the single-use restart_app tool. Exactly one criterion (cw_save_reload_restart, functional judge.toml:339-345) calls restart_app, the functional prompt section 'Restart evidence' names the tool and server, and the other four prompts say 'Never restart the app'. (4) Criteria: render 1, constraints 2, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3 (matches the 3 gate / 43 Functional / 6 Polish counts in the evidence index). Ids are unique per file and across files, name equals id, every description is non-empty, every weight is positive (functional uses 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0, the rest 1.0). Gate criteria are all 'type = "binary"'; functional and polish are all binary; the three visual criteria are 'type = "likert"' with 'points = 5' and written anchors 5 to 0, the same shape as the template visual dimension. (5) Prompts resolve: each of the five prompt.md files exists beside its judge.toml, contains exactly the two placeholders {app_context} and {criteria} and no other brace token, opens http://localhost:3000, and carries the untrusted-evidence line; test.sh substitutes {app_context} from tests/app_context.md, which has the Application, Accounts and Key screens sections. (6) Budgets nest: gate judges 600 + 600 = 1200 < 1500; scored judges 9000 + 900 + 900 = 10800 < 11100; 1500 + 11100 = 12600 < verifier timeout_sec 13200; all values equal the template. Notes, none of them a defect in this row: (a) the private checkers check-rubric-schema.py and check-scoring-policy.py were not available, so their documented behaviour was applied by hand; this is not a portal checker run. (b) No configured judge run exists for these bytes; the hosted run in the evidence index is on an earlier candidate and only shows that this wiring shape launches and grades. (c) The visual prompt keeps the template's 0 to 5 anchor wording against a points = 5 likert; this is template-inherited and belongs to row 41, not here. (d) The frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx and the skill's assets/WebDev_Rubrics_QC.xlsx have different SHA256 values; the row 24 text I relied on comes from the former, and the skill reference section 24 agrees with it.
